$comment: Aeromexico Virtual brand manifest. This file is the contract between this website and the Inflight Crew Center. Paste the `theme` object into the Crew Center's Appearance → Brand theme field (or POST it to /api/crew/aeromexico-virtual/settings as {"theme": …}) and the crew center renders in this exact design system. Every value here mirrors a token in assets/brand.css — keep the two in step.
$comment_motifs: Only design TOKENS cross this boundary — the crew center maps each key onto a CSS custom property, and nothing here is ever interpreted as CSS. The site's ornament (greca, talavera, papel picado, the Quetzalcóatl watermark) is drawn in assets/img/ and does not travel. What travels is the palette, the type and the shape, which is enough for the two products to read as one airline.

theme.$comment_gradient: Stored as the ARGUMENTS to linear-gradient(), not the whole function. The crew center wraps it, so nothing but colours, angles and stops can cross the boundary. Deliberately ONE hue now: this is a depth wash for dark panels, not decoration. The old blue → plum → pink sweep is gone on purpose — see the header of assets/brand.css.
